pages.text: A Scepter of Revelation is used to query information about specific Arcane Archives blocks if used while sneaking. The following blocks have interactions with a Scepter of Revelation.
Scepters of Revelation are also used as a crafting component for other Scepters.$(br2)Scepters of Revelation can be crafted conventionally.

$()$(italic) A series of simple divination spells grants this scepter a number of useful information divining abilities. It is standard University procedure to gather data from your experiments using primarily your Scepter of Revelation. $()

$()$(italic) Should your experiments be likely to result in personal injury, your Scepter of Revelation is imbued with a danger-sensing spell and will begin to vibrate wildly. In such a case, you have approximately sixty seconds to vacate the premises. $()$(br2)$()$(italic) The Eternal University is not responsible for healing injuries sustained by careless laboratory procedure. $()

$()$(bold) The Apprentice's Panoply $()$(br2)...Form letter given to all Apprentices of the Eternal University$(br2)$()$(italic) Interesting. The Scepter of Revelation’s ability to divine information appears to be greatly enhanced when the crystalline material (which I have dubbed Radiant Quartz) is attached as a prism of sorts. $()

$()$(italic) Unlike my previous instruments, using this newly improved Scepter of Revelation is returning consistent results from my storage contraption. $()$(br2)$()$(italic) Unfortunately, it seems to have lost its precognitive warning capabilities. $()$(br2)$()$(bold) Addendum $()$(br2)...Sharaveda$(br2)...1665, Summer's Birth
